# RUTUBE

> > RUTUBE is Russia's leading video streaming platform offering movies, TV series, blogger content, and live broadcasts with features like PREMIER premium service, Shorts, and creator monetization.

RUTUBE serves as a Russian alternative to YouTube, providing video hosting, streaming services, and content partnerships with platforms like PREMIER, START, and viju. The platform supports creators through monetization programs, verification systems, and tools for migrating content from other platforms.

## Key Topics

- RUTUBE platform
- Video streaming
- PREMIER subscription service
- Shorts (short-form video)
- Content monetization
- Channel verification
- YouTube migration
- Russian video content
- Студия RUTUBE (RUTUBE Studio)
- Video embedding
- START streaming
- Offline viewing
- Content moderation
- Blogger channels
- Live TV broadcasts

## Platform Overview

- [RUTUBE - смотрите видео онлайн, бесплатно.](https://rutube.ru): Russian video platform homepage with movies, series, sports & bloggers
- [RUTUBE - смотреть видео онлайн, бесплатно](https://rutube.ru/feeds/new_main_group_d): Main feed with recommendations, trending content & new blogger videos
- [Каталог: популярные категории видео](https://rutube.ru/categories): Video categories directory including PREMIER, START, anime & business
- [Смотреть бесплатно и без рекламы: Главная](https://rutube.ru/feeds/rk): Ad-free viewing page featuring series, originals & TV shows
